name: OMOPHub API
description: REST API for the OHDSI OMOP standardized vocabularies: search, map and navigate 11M+ medical concepts across 120+ vocabularies such as SNOMED CT, ICD-10, LOINC and RxNorm.
notes: Healthcare data teams use it to look up and map clinical codes without running a local ATHENA vocabulary database. Features include semantic and multilingual search, cross-vocabulary mappings, concept hierarchies, vocabulary release pinning and a FHIR-to-OMOP resolver. The free plan includes 3,000 calls per month with no card; requests pause at the quota and there are no overage charges. Docs are public at docs.omophub.com and the OpenAPI 3.0 spec is public.
